transformed_hypotheses.name: EXPLICIT_SEMANTIC_DISPOSITION_BEFORE_EXECUTION
transformed_hypotheses.claim: Content-addressed semantic identity/preservation is necessary but insufficient. Every residual semantic class crossing an executable ClayCode boundary must receive an explicit current disposition: LOWERED_AND_VALIDATED, EXPLICITLY_DEFERRED_FAIL_CLOSED, or REJECTED_WITH_REASON. Preserved opaque semantics cannot implicitly execute or mint effect authority.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: A real self-hosted Ubuntu receipt narrowly promoted the WP03 production TypedIR bridge while leaving 100 residual nodes across 10 classes unlowered and WP03 OPEN. The strongest remaining failure mode is therefore downstream semantic stranding, not byte/identity loss alone.
transformed_hypotheses.external_analogue: LLVM MLIR DialectConversion explicitly separates legal/dynamic/illegal/unknown operations and partial versus full legalization.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Generic opaque preservation and a generic downstream consumer are sufficient; explicit class-level disposition adds complexity without correctness gain.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Complete the 10-class WP04 legality + WP05 consumption/fail-closed matrix with semantic mutation, unsupported-class, tamper and no-authority-minting controls, compared to a generic-consumer baseline.

transformed_hypotheses.name: ANCESTRY_AWARE_PROJECTION_COMPLETENESS
transformed_hypotheses.claim: Completeness confidence for live-fusion routing must account for failure ancestry, not merely the number of projections. Multiple views derived from the same upstream assumptions may fail together and must not be counted as independent safety evidence. High-impact routing therefore needs ancestry-aware confidence plus anti-entropy, independently derived audit evidence when available, dense fallback, or explicit degraded coordination.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: The V3 synthetic dual-plane evidence produced the qualitative result that correlated control planes showed no recall benefit, while its numeric results failed reproducibility. Epoch-20 owner policy simultaneously makes all-source intake/re-entry mandatory, increasing the cost of false completeness confidence.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Same-ancestry multiple projections are sufficient when reconciliation is robust; ancestry-diverse auditing adds unnecessary cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Receipt-bound reproducible simulator and real-repo Ubuntu replay comparing correlated dual views, independently derived audit view, and dense fallback under upstream-shared faults, view-local faults, stale edges, duplicates, reorder and restart.

transformed_hypotheses.name: EXPLICIT_CONTRADICTION_RETRIEVAL_AND_ABSTENTION_LANE
transformed_hypotheses.claim: For hypothesis screening and high-impact research retrieval, similarity/relevance retrieval should be complemented by an explicit contradiction/refutation retrieval lane whose outputs remain separate evidence and can increase abstention or trigger discriminating tests rather than being averaged into consensus.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: Independent contradiction-retrieval research provides a concrete mechanism-level alternative to assuming diversified relevance retrieval is enough. This turns a general anti-confirmation principle into a falsifiable retrieval architecture candidate.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Diversified hybrid relevance retrieval plus model-side critical reasoning achieves equal contradiction coverage with less noise and cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Frozen project hypothesis corpus with known support/refutation pairs: relevance-only, diversified hybrid, and explicit contradiction lane; measure contradiction recall, false-conflict rate, calibration/abstention, downstream hypothesis disposition and resource cost.

transformed_hypotheses.name: MATERIALITY_GATED_OMNISOURCE_RESEARCH_REENTRY
transformed_hypotheses.claim: The owner-fixed all-new-data source-coverage law should be implemented as cursor-bounded intake plus provenance-preserving deduplication and materiality gating: low-value/duplicate observations remain indexed or digest-only, while each material semantic delta must close a ResearchReentryReceipt into hypothesis/counterhypothesis, experiment, architecture/test/work, negative result, or explicit NO_CHANGE.
transformed_hypotheses.what_changed: Epoch 20 converts continuous source coverage and research re-entry from optional live-fusion direction into project operating law while leaving the V3 mechanism candidate evidence-gated.
transformed_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Per-observation re-entry creates recursive noise/backpressure; bounded periodic fusion reaches equal material-delta recall at lower total cost.
transformed_hypotheses.highest_information_test: Matched periodic-batch versus omnisource incremental replay over current repo/work/source cursors with duplicate, conflict, gap, outage and crash faults; require zero stranded material deltas and measure false materiality, re-entry latency, interrupts and total resources.

fusion2_meta_invariant: Availability, preservation, connectivity and re-entry are separate from truth and execution authority. Optimization may remove structure only after semantic identity, explicit executability disposition, provenance, recipient completeness, causal use/effect closure and recovery remain measured.
